exposure: compound heterozygous variants of SNX14 gene (c.712A>T and c.2744A>T)
cohort: A family consisting of a proband, her older sister, and their parents, where the two children exhibited growth and developmental delays.
finding: The compound heterozygous SNX14 gene variants c.712A>T (p.Arg238Ter) and c.2744A>T (p.Gln915Leu) were identified as the genetic causes of growth and developmental delay in two affected children.
